newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK AGROBANK CALLS ON EGNATIA BANK FOR NEGOTIATIONS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK AGROBANK CALLS ON EGNATIA BANK FOR NEGOTIATIONS.

text.p: Greece's state Agricultural Bank called on private Egnatia bank to begin negotiations for the sale of its majority stake in the Bank of Central Greece , it said in a statement.
Egnatia Bank was the only bank to submit a binding bid for Agricultural Bank's stake in the Bank of Central Greece, out of six that expressed interest in the earlier stage of the tender.
The board of Agricultural Bank decided to go ahead after meeting with National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou on Thursday, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
